articles.summary: The European Union’s Radio Equipment Directive (RED) cybersecurity requirements go into effect in August 2025. These requirements mandate that device manufacturers secure network-connected products sold in Europe. This post breaks down what’s in scope, what compliance requires, and how to assess readiness at scale.
articles.title: Navigating EU RED Compliance: Meeting the August 2025 Deadline
